title: lint: six publish-time checks for metadata that passes the schema and does nothing at run time
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent objectstack-ai/objectstack#34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic), filed on the maintainer's word in this seat's chat, 2026-11-17, verbatim: 「三点都同意，按最终计划把后续里程碑的卡全部立出来」, and, on the list of thirteen cards the seat then showed: 「同意」. The ruling records are objectstack-ai/objectstack#34659 comment 6940528935 and objectstack-ai/objectstack#34691 comment 6943107981. Readings: objectstack `a0326b06`, cloud `53a5844`, 2026-11-17.

## Why

These are the mistakes an AI author makes most quietly: the item saves, publishes and never works. Today the hosted product warns its model about them in prose and catches some in a private check; the open platform catches none of the six. The maintainer ruled that such a rule becomes a check first and prose second (E1).

Who acts: the spec lane (`packages/lint`, `packages/spec`). Reader: every author, human or AI, at publish time.

## Evidence

- Flow node `type` is an open string; only three reserved names are refused (`packages/spec/src/automation/flow.zod.ts:683-692`). A node with no executor fails every run with `NO_EXECUTOR`; the engine only logs a warning once the vocabulary is sealed.
- Approval decisions continue down out-edges labelled `approve` / `reject` (`packages/spec/src/automation/approval.zod.ts:493-511`); the lint checks `revise` edges only (`packages/lint/src/lint-flow-patterns.ts:224-232`).
- A boolean field marked `required`: no rule in spec or lint. The create form then refuses an unchecked switch.
- A `state_machine` validation without `initialStates`: the key is optional (`packages/spec/src/data/validation.zod.ts:197`); the lint checks seed rows only.
- An `http` flow node without `timeoutMs`: optional in the spec (`flow.zod.ts:776`).
- An action bound to no object: `validateActionLocations` runs on the CLI only (`packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts:1804`).
- The hosted product's own graph check already reports each of these six under a private code, which shows they occur.

## Scope

- Six rules in the authoring registry, runtime publish gate and CLI. The first four and the last are errors; the missing timeout is a warning unless the lane reads it otherwise from the engine.
- The node-type rule judges against the sealed executor vocabulary, never against a registry still filling at boot.
- Each finding names the fix. Each rule has a positive and a negative pin.
- When a rule lands, the matching trap leaves the skills and the hosted rule text (#34690).

## Done when

- Publishing each of six fixture items raises its finding; `examples/app-crm` and the showcase raise none.

## Relations

- Parent: objectstack-ai/objectstack#34659. Ruling: E1 = A, enforce first. These are product rules an author sees at publish, ruled by name, not repository gates.
- Dedup, open and closed: `NO_EXECUTOR lint flow node type` none; `approval edge label approve reject lint` none.
